hero.desc.0: Access our corporate brochure, product literature, and engineering resources. Request detailed datasheets, GA drawings, and custom proposals through our team.
p.0: Access our corporate brochure, product literature, and engineering resources. Request detailed datasheets, GA drawings, and custom proposals through our team.
p.1: Complete overview of Gausin International Engineers - our capabilities in evaporation, drying, dairy processing, waste management, turnkey EPC services, industries served, and why leading organizations trust us.
p.2: Falling film, forced circulation, plate-type, rising film, and batch vacuum pan evaporators for dairy, pharma, chemical, and food industries.
p.3: Spray dryers, spin flash dryers, fluidized bed dryers, ATFD, and closed-circuit drying systems for powders and solids.
p.4: Complete milk processing, chilling, pasteurization, butter, ghee lines, and dairy equipment - FSSAI / 3-A compliant systems.
p.5: ETP/STP plants, biogas & CNG, scrubbers, incinerators, WTP/RO systems, and biomass waste treatment - CPCB compliant.
p.6: Shell & tube and plate-type heat exchangers for process heating, cooling, and utility duties across industries.
p.7: Automated clean-in-place systems with recipe-based sequencing for dairy, food, and pharma hygienic process lines.
p.8: Detailed technical datasheets with specifications, materials, capacities, and instrumentation for any product in our catalogue.
p.9: General arrangement drawings, P&ID layouts, and equipment sizing documents for project evaluation and approval.
p.10: ASME, IBR, FSSAI, CPCB compliance documentation, material test certificates, and inspection reports on request.
p.11: Share your process requirements, capacity, and application details - our engineering team will prepare a tailored solution with specifications, layout, and commercial proposal within 24 - 48 hours.
